name: Tier IV, Inc.
summary: Tier IV, Inc. develops open-source software solutions for autonomous driving. It develops Autoware, which is a software for urban driverless cars and supports 3D localization, object detection, path planning and following, and lane detection. In addition, the company offers self-driving development kit; autoware loggers; and autoware remove drive kit. It also offers sensor fusion technologies and products, including laser scanners and cameras. It also offers mobility services, development services, and solution services, covering deployment of autonomous driving systems, system integration, testing, operation support, and maintenance.
